english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something repulsive, gross, or distasteful.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for a thing that is disgusting, repellent, or objectionable.
This is the everyday choice for something that causes disgust, rather than something merely outrageous or financially gross.
Use this when the abhorrent thing feels disgusting, repulsive, or morally gross rather than merely disliked.
Choose this when a person, thing, or food is disgusting or loathsome rather than merely physically dirty.
Use this when the ugliness is repulsive or disgusting, including a nasty sound or morally offensive conduct, rather than merely unattractive.
Use this when the detestable thing is gross, disgusting, or offensive to the senses.
Use this colloquial choice when grim means disgusting or gross.
